title: Anthropic 請 Accenture 進駐當評估者：雙方各投至少 10 億美元

sources.title: Anthropic：Partnering with Accenture on embedded evaluation
Dario Amodei：We Must Pace the Frontier
Anthropic Newsroom（新聞總覽頁，本篇標註 Sep 18, 2026）

verified_facts: 公告標題是 Partnering with Accenture on embedded evaluation，日期標示 Sep 18, 2026（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
第一句：We're partnering with Accenture on independent evaluation of frontier AI.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
官方把這件事稱為朝向執行長文章〈We Must Pace the Frontier〉裡「把評估者放進 Anthropic 內部」那項承諾邁出的重要一步（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
合作由 Accenture 旗下專攻 AI 的事業體 Faculty 主導：The partnership will be led by Faculty, Accenture's specialist AI business（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
工作內容：evaluating and red-teaming models, conducting alignment assessments, and testing model safeguards（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）

挑選理由：Accenture helps businesses and governments deploy AI across many industries. Their understanding of how enterprises use AI in practice informs their safety approach（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
投入規模：Anthropic and Accenture each expect to invest at least $1 billion in building capacity in this area over the next five years.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
內嵌式評估是新做法、細節仍在討論：Embedded evaluation is new, and many of the details about how it will operate are still being worked out.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
與外部評估者的差別：Unlike today's external evaluators, embedded evaluators will work inside AI companies, with access comparable to an employee's.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）

這個位置能做的事：watch models take shape in training, follow the decisions that govern how those models are built and deployed, and speak directly to employees（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）

還能做的事：assess how a company operates, verify that it is keeping its safety commitments, and identify blind spots. They can also report incidents and give the public a more informed account of benefits and risks.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）

劃界線的一句：independent embedded evaluators do not reduce our accountability, but help to make it more verifiable. The safety of our models remains our responsibility.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）

尚無標準：There are, as yet, no standards for what information embedded evaluators should have access to, or how they should report what they find. There is also no settled system for funding independent evaluation.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
長期經費方向：Long-term, we think funding should come from pooled or government sources, as we called for in our Advanced AI Framework in June.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
目前的付費安排：Given the importance and urgency of this work, Anthropic will fund Accenture's work directly.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）

與非營利評估機構的討論：We are also in dialogue with METR and other nonprofit evaluators to pilot elements of embedded evaluation using their own funding.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）

非專屬：Our partnership is non-exclusive; Anthropic will work with other evaluators to be announced in the coming weeks, and Accenture will work with other AI developers in similar capacities.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）
結尾：We'll continue to train and release frontier models, and we want independent evaluators working alongside us as we do.（https://www.anthropic.com/news/accenture-embedded-evaluation）

文章把內嵌評估者列為三步驟的第一步，承諾內容是 giving ongoing, employee-like access to a team of embedded third-party evaluators (such as METR), whose role is to verify adherence to safety practices and commitments, report incidents, and help assess the alignment of not just completed AI models but training pipelines and processes（https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier）
文章稱這是可驗證性的關鍵，並舉銀行業為前例：has precedent in the banking industry, which sometimes involves regulatory "supervisors" embedded along with employees（https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier）
Anthropic 在文章裡單方面承諾這一步：Anthropic is unilaterally committing to this step now.（https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier）

文章列的三個好處分別標為 Verifiability、Transparency、Second Opinion，其中透明那一段寫 But we are still the ones choosing what to include and omit. Embedded evaluators will change this dynamic.（https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier）
新聞總覽頁的列表把這篇標為 Sep 18, 2026、分類 Announcements（https://www.anthropic.com/news）
unverified_or_excluded: 公告連到的 Advanced AI Framework 是一份 PDF（www-cdn.anthropic.com 上的檔案）。BRIEF 規定沒有 pypdf 就不要用 PDF 來源，本輪沒有抽取它的內文，所以文章只寫到「六月的一份框架文件」以及公告轉述的那一句主張，沒有引用框架本身的任何條文。
Accenture 與旗下 Faculty 沒有找到對應的官方新聞稿；本文所有關於 Accenture 的敘述都出自 Anthropic 的公告，文中已標明是官方的說法。沒有拿任何媒體報導補。
公告沒有寫人數、時程、評估結果的公開門檻、評估者與員工之間的保密安排，也沒有寫這套做法會不會適用到其他公司。這些都列在文章最後一節，標明為官方沒有交代的部分，沒有推測。
受評估方直接付錢給評估者的利益衝突，公告沒有處理。文章把結構寫出來並指出公告沒有說明，沒有替任何一方辯護或指控。
METR 的官方網站只用來確認這個名稱存在，沒有拿它當 source，也沒有引用它的任何說法；公告寫的是「正在討論」，不是已經成案。
執行長那篇文章還有節奏承諾、民主協調、全球協調等其他主張，以及對齊、可解釋性等段落，都與本則新聞無關，沒有寫進來；站上另有一篇專講那篇文章的報導。
editorial_brief: 這則的切角不是「又一個合作案」，而是一種治理安排第一次有了具名的執行對象，以及官方自己承認的三處空白（沒有存取標準、沒有回報標準、沒有經費制度）。刻意把公告裡「不減少我們的責任」那句話與「由受評估方直接付費」這個結構並列，讓讀者自己判斷。本站沒有實測也沒有參與，全文所有說法都歸因。不重寫站上已有的〈Anthropic 公布三項前沿 AI 指標〉與〈We Must Pace the Frontier〉兩篇講過的事。
